tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia boosts its buyback to $150B, topping Apple, as yields and Nasdaq hit records. Reported by Seoul Economic Daily: ASML acquires SVG to lead EUV tech.
Mistral unveils Le Chonk, OpenAI adds watermark, and SpaceX eyes Nvidia chips. Reported by CNBC TV18: these moves shape the artificial intelligence landscape.
Antom and Google Gemini launch artificial intelligence access in Indonesia for 10M users via digital platforms. Reported by Cyprus Shipping News: Ant International's Antom supports Google Gemini expanding access to artificial intelligence service in Asia.
DeepSeek raises 100B yuan and plans 160K artificial intelligence chips, targeting an IPO next year. Reported by SBS News: DeepSeek nears completion of its 100 billion yuan funding round at 500 billion yuan valuation.
Artificial intelligence server supply chains are moving toward regional manufacturing as robots still can't build Nvidia's servers as well as people can. Reported by digitimes: this shift reshapes global production.
Free every hour.
